title: Implement Pricing section variant (pricing-cards)
description: Implement a Pricing section with tiered pricing cards. The most popular tier can be visually highlighted. Suitable for businesses offering tiered service packages.
acceptanceCriteria: Accepts `{ content: PricingContent, business: BusinessInfo }` props
Renders all pricing tiers with name, price, and feature list
Highlighted tier is visually distinct (border, scale, badge)
CTA button on each tier links to `#contact`
Verify in browser with Playwright screenshot

steps.details: Headline + grid of tier cards `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3`. Each card: tier name (h3), price, feature list with checkmarks. Highlighted card: `border-2 border-[--color-primary]`, 'Most Popular' badge, slightly scaled up. CTA button per card.
Take Playwright screenshot. Verify highlighted tier is visually distinct, feature checkmarks are visible.
